description: Compare two immutable versions of a private data contract and report added, removed, and changed schema paths. Useful for reviewing upstream API contract changes before publishing or upgrading an agent. Example: invoke contract_compare with the required arguments shown in its input schema; use the workspace or resource credentials issued by Zorqelio, never placeholder credentials in production.

accessToken.description: Secret access token issued for this contract.

fromVersion.description: Value for the fromVersion parameter of the contract_compare tool; follow its schema constraints.

operationId.description: Stable unique request identifier. Reuse it only for an exact retry.

toVersion.description: Value for the toVersion parameter of the contract_compare tool; follow its schema constraints.

name: contract_compare
